verdict.rationale: Activepieces does not show a built-in insights or suggestions feature. You can, however, brief an AI agent in plain language to pull live data from connected apps and act on it, for example "summarise my unread emails every morning," so you get AI-generated output from your data only by building an agent first. missing for 10: native in-product insights or suggestions surfaced automatically from user data (e.g. over tables or run history), documentation describing an insights/analytics capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.
